title: Coordination of Benefits Policy for Insurance Coverage & Claims
content:
When a patient has more than one live coverage under **Insurance Coverage & Claims**, the payment order is fixed by the rules below, applied in this order.

## Payment order rules

1. A Medicare Supplement Plan is never primary and pays only after Original Medicare Part B, by automatic crossover.
2. Medicaid Managed Care Plan pays last, after every other coverage.
3. TRICARE Prime and Select pays after any other health coverage except Medicaid.
4. Between a Medicare payer class and an employer group plan, the employer plan is primary when it comes from the current employment of the patient or spouse and the employer has at least the payer class's employer size threshold of employees; otherwise Medicare is primary.
5. Between two commercial plans, the plan where the patient is the subscriber is primary; for a child covered by both parents, the plan of the parent whose birthday (month and day) falls earlier in the year is primary.

The payer class attributes these rules read (whether a payer class can be primary, whether it pays after other health coverage, its employer size threshold and its secondary-claim filing period) are per payer class figures of the product.

## Filing against the payment order

- **First claim.** The first claim for an order goes only to the coverage that is primary on the date of service and active on that date. This is decided from the coverage records (payment order, status, effective date and termination date of the coverage the claim is filed with), not from the caller's statement.
- **Secondary claim.** A secondary claim is filed only after the primary payer's remittance, within the payer class's secondary-claim filing period in calendar days of it, and for the amount the primary left unpaid.
- **Automatic crossover.** When the secondary payer class receives claims automatically from Medicare, the laboratory files nothing and records the crossover claim when the secondary payer acknowledges it.
- **Changing the order on file.** The coordination order on file changes only through a coverage details update made after the patient has updated their other-coverage information with the payer.

## Decision table (hypothetical patients)

| Coverages held | Employment facts | Primary |
|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B and an employer group plan | Plan from the spouse's current employment, employer of 20 or more employees | The employer plan |
| Original Medicare Part B and an employer group plan | Plan from a former employer | Original Medicare Part B |
| Commercial In-Network Plan and Medicaid Managed Care Plan | — | The commercial plan (Medicaid pays last) |
| TRICARE Prime and Select and Commercial In-Network Plan | — | The commercial plan |
| Child on both parents' commercial plans; mother born 3 March, father born 9 July | — | The mother's plan (earlier birthday in the year) |

In the first two rows the figure of 20 employees is the employer size threshold carried by Original Medicare Part B.
